description:
Searches the web, at the chosen source: online stores, social networks, ad libraries, search trends, search by photo. Useful to see what sells and what is rising, in the US as in Europe. Sources:
· web: Google results
· google_shopping: products for sale and their prices (gl, hl: country and language)
· google_images: Google images
· youtube: YouTube videos
· tendances: search interest over time (geo: country, time: period, data_type)
· tendances_du_jour: what is rising today (geo: country)
· autocompletion: what people type after these words
· photo: where a product sells, from the https address of its photo (country)
· amazon_recherche: Amazon products, prices, reviews (amazon_domain: amazon.com, amazon.fr…)
· amazon_produit: an Amazon product page, by its ASIN (amazon_domain)
· amazon_offres: the offers of an Amazon product, by its ASIN (amazon_domain)
· amazon_meilleures_ventes: Amazon best sellers (amazon_domain, category_id, bestseller_type)
· ebay: eBay products (ebay_domain)
· walmart: Walmart products (US)
· tiktok_videos: TikTok videos, views and likes (returned from most to least viewed, unless sort_by: most-liked, date-posted; “produits” groups the shop products pushed by several videos; date_posted: yesterday, this-week, this-month, last-3-months, last-6-months; region: the country you watch from, not a filter — each video states its region; cursor: the returned “suite”, for the next page)
· tiktok_shop: TikTok Shop products, their price and their sales (region: US…; page)
· pubs_meta: Facebook and Instagram ads (country: US, FR…; active_status, sort_by)
· pubs_meta_pages: the pages that advertise on Facebook and Instagram (country)
· pub_meta_detail: the detail of a Meta ad, by its ad_details_token
· page_meta: a Meta advertiser page, by its page_id
· pubs_tiktok: TikTok ads — Europe, United Kingdom and Turkey only (country)
· pub_tiktok_detail: the detail of a TikTok ad, by its ad_id
“requete”: the words (or the photo address, the ASIN, the ad identifier, depending on the source). “parametres”: the source’s other settings, as they are (e.g. {"amazon_domain":"amazon.com"}, {"country":"US"}, {"gl":"us","hl":"en"}, {"next_page_token":"…"} for the next page). Results come back raw, in the site’s language and currency. Counts one search against the client’s quota on every call. Queries SearchApi (https://www.searchapi.io): “parametres” follows its documentation.

parametres.description: The source’s other settings (text, numbers, yes/no).

requete.description: The words searched for, or the identifier the source asks for.

name: web_search
title: Web search
